MultiRaceRules: A character may only multi-race once.
A character may take their race to 8th level; 7th/8th are specialised via 'points app' processes.
A published multi-race may begin at 8th level.
A non-standard multi-race requires 1000 points post-8th before starting.
While progressing a standard multi-race, character may multi-class freely unless noted otherwise.
Some races may take a second published race as class in specific progression cases only.
CostsNotes: Published values in Races.pdf tables are cumulative totals; CostsByLevel stores converted per-level deltas.
